items.q: [INTERVIEWER] She also sang a song of (inaudible) called, 'Linda Lou, honey, did you hear that mockingbird sing?' [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: She sang that -- 'Won't you come with me in my great teepee and let me fold you in my' -- something like that.
